desc:
Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5 is a tactical openworld shooter with vast maps and thrilling gameplay. Engage in team-based combat throughout multiple openworld gamemodes, including the new Kingdom of Sawang map. Go head to head in PvP or even build out your own Headquarters to boost your income offline and research powerful weapons.

• Customize your operator with over 1000+ unique outfit combinations.
• Build your dream gun with 70+ choices and over 100 attachments. 
• Purchase and own 20+ vehicles, boats and helicopters from modern militaries. 
• Multiple engaging gamemodes with many hours of fun ahead.
• Make your own custom scenarios and maps with the Sandbox Mode. [Realtime Game Editor]

PC, Console, and Mobile are supported. 
Headphones recommended for best audio experience. All music is non-copyright and streamer safe.

Based on PlatinumFive's original Military RP games.

badges.name: Calm Before The Storm
badges.desc: Before every storm is a period of tranquility; a moment in time to breathe and reflect before the storm passes over. Obtain this badge by experiencing what it truly means to be calm... before the storm.

badges.name: The Musician
badges.desc: Your job as a soldier is to not only fight the enemy, but to protect your own. Obtain this badge by completing one of K.P.'s quests.

badges.name: It's Not Over
badges.desc: Your efforts have proved yourself as a competent operator. Obtain this badge by participating in the Ronograd Bunker Raid.

badges.name: Lost Souls
badges.desc: Your failure has changed the course of humanity forever. Obtain this badge by participating in the Ronograd Bunker Raid.

badges.name: Operation Typhoon Stage One Response
badges.desc: Obtain this badge by playing Operation Typhoon within the first 24 hours of release.
